description: Query historical pricing snapshots recorded over time. Use this to look up past prices for a model or provider, or to see how prices have changed over a given number of days.

limit.description: Maximum number of snapshot rows to return (default: 50, max: 500)

model_name.description: Filter by model name (e.g. 'gpt-4o'). Omit for all models.

provider.description: Filter by provider (e.g. 'openai'). Omit for all providers.

name: get_pricing_history
